Meta-analysis of diagnostic or prognostic studies with sensitivity analyses on the SROC Curve anf the tim-dependent SROC curve

DiagProgMeta-package.Rd

This package implements the likelihood-based sensitivity analysis for publication bias on the summary receiver operating characteristic (SROC) curve and the area under the SROC curve (SAUC) in meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy, see Zhou et al. (2023) doi:10.1002/sim.9643 . It also provides the sensitivity analysis on the time-dependent SROC curve in meta-analysis of prognostic studies, where the time-dependent sensitivity and specificity are reconstructed from the published survival probabilities, see Combescure et al. (2016) doi:10.1177/0962280212464542 .

Main functions:

  • srocsa.t Sensitivity analysis for publication bias on the SROC curve and SAUC.

  • tsrocsa.lrt Sensitivity analysis for publication bias on the time-dependent SROC curve and SAUC.

  • reitsma.sroc Bivariate random-effects model for the SROC curve without publication bias.

  • hattori.tsroc Time-dependent SROC curve without publication bias.

  • sauc SAUC and its confidence interval.

Results output functions:

  • print.srocsa Print the main results from 'srocsa' objects.

  • summary.srocsa Summarize the results from 'srocsa' objects.

  • plot.srocsa Plot the SROC curves from 'srocsa' objects.

Example data:

  • IVD, CD64 Meta-analyses of diagnostic studies.
